As others have answered, yes. To be exact, though, you HAVE to burn the
spying mission the next time that minion successfully bleeds. Doesn't
matter how they do it (by declaration of bleed action or Night Moves or any
other type of bleed action), but the spying mission MUST be burned.

Spying Mission
[obf] This acting vampire gets +1 stealth. [OBF] Only usable -when a bleed
is successful-. Instead of removing pool from the Methuselah you're
bleeding, put this card on the acting vampire. *The next time this vampire
successfully bleeds the same Methuselah, burn this card for +2 bleed.

*Relevant text

BTW, this is one drawback to using Spying Mission as a solution to bleed
bounce (altough it is a mainstay for my stealth bleed decks that use OBF
now). If the same minion is deflected again, you bleed your grand prey for
a LOT more than you would have in the original action.
